text:
Situation: As of 2026-10-21, Corvale East holds 106 tablets of lamotrigine 150 mg (18.1 days on hand) and Corvale General holds 218 tablets (28.2 days on hand). FDA's drug shortage list does not show lamotrigine as of 2026-10-21.

Why (FDA record): FDA's drug shortage list shows lamotrigine is not listed as of 2026-10-21. FDA status is recorded as "To Be Discontinued since -" with no date provided.

Our position: Current inventory provides less than one month of supply at both sites. Multiple manufacturers not on FDA's shortage list are available for purchase. No FDA record states a shortage exists or explains the "To Be Discontinued" status.

Recommended actions:
1. Buyer to place orders with Actavis Pharma, Inc. (top-ranked option) — requires buyer approval.
2. Buyer to place orders with Advagen Pharma Limited (second option) if Actavis supply is insufficient — requires buyer approval.
3. Buyer to place orders with Ajanta Pharma USA Inc. (third option) if prior options are insufficient — requires buyer approval.
4. Buyer to monitor inventory daily and report days on hand to P&T committee weekly — requires buyer and P&T chair approval.
5. P&T committee to review therapeutic alternatives if supply cannot be secured within 14 days — requires P&T committee approval.

Not recommended: Delaying procurement pending FDA shortage listing; relying on a single manufacturer; initiating therapeutic substitutions without P&T committee review.
